subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “An old theater was damaged by fire.”?
options: They wanted people to stop throwing away things that could still be fixed.
Some people wanted to build a modern shopping center in its place.
Some people wanted to build a parking lot.
Its sound was rougher than the modern bell, but people listened closely.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「They wanted people to stop throwing away things that could still be fixed.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Some people wanted to build a modern shopping center in its place.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Some people wanted to build a parking lot.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Its sound was rougher than the modern bell, but people listened closely.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
